parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: IsRelease
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to retrieve published application pages.
- **true**: Retrieves published application pages.
- **false (default)**: Retrieves unpublished application pages.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb), select the target instance in the upper-left corner, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar.
